scripts.postinstall: cd backend-bookstore && npm install && cd ../frontend-bookstore && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix backend-bookstore run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend-bookstore run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend-bookstore run build && npm --prefix frontend-bookstore run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend-bookstore test && npm --prefix backend-bookstore run test:e2e
